clips.text: Why does so much of the world rely on dollars?
clips.phonemes: wˌaɪ dˈʌz sˈoʊ mˌʌtʃ ʌvðə wˈɜːld ɹᵻlˈaɪ ˌɔn dˈɑːlɚz?

clips.text: Deep U.S. financial markets make dollars easy to trade and hold.
clips.phonemes: dˈiːp jˈuː.ˈɛs. faɪnˈænʃəl mˈɑːɹkɪts mˌeɪk dˈɑːlɚz ˈiːzi tə tɹˈeɪd ænd hˈoʊld.

clips.text: As more people accept dollars, they become more useful to others.
clips.phonemes: æz mˈɔːɹ pˈiːpəl ɐksˈɛpt dˈɑːlɚz, ðeɪ bɪkˌʌm mˈɔːɹ jˈuːsfəl tʊ ˈʌðɚz.

clips.text: That helps the dollar lead, but it's not the only global currency.
clips.phonemes: ðæt hˈɛlps ðə dˈɑːlɚ lˈiːd, bˌʌt ɪts nˌɑːt ðɪ ˈoʊnli ɡlˈoʊbəl kˈɜːɹənsi.
